concepts.label: Coordinate
concepts.definition: Position coordinate in an explicitly specified frame.

concepts.label: Geodetic angular coordinate
concepts.definition: Angular position on a specified geodetic reference ellipsoid.

concepts.label: Geodetic latitude
concepts.definition: Angle between the ellipsoid normal and the equatorial plane; north positive.

concepts.label: Geodetic longitude
concepts.definition: Angular position eastward from the reference meridian.

concepts.label: Depth coordinate
concepts.definition: Depth position relative to an established reference, with a declared direction.
constraints: A quantity of length does not make depth positions summable.

concepts.label: Ellipsoidal depth
concepts.definition: Negative ellipsoidal height measured along the ellipsoid normal: positive inward from the reference ellipsoid.
constraints: Depth = -ellipsoidal height; not a geoid or mean-sea-level depth.

concepts.label: Geodetic position with ellipsoidal depth
concepts.definition: Position specified by geodetic latitude, longitude and ellipsoidal depth.

concepts.label: Total gravity vector
concepts.definition: Local acceleration vector including gravitational and centrifugal contributions.
constraints: Contains acceleration components; scalar gravity potential is a separate result, not a vector component.

concepts.label: Total gravity acceleration
concepts.definition: Component or magnitude of total gravity acceleration, including centrifugal acceleration.
constraints: Magnitude is nonnegative; signed components are not magnitudes.

concepts.label: Total gravity potential
concepts.definition: Total gravitational plus centrifugal potential returned by the gravity model.
constraints: Uses the geodetic sign convention: gravity is the gradient of total potential.
Meaningful precision of 0.01 m^2/s^2 is a display convention, not model accuracy.

concepts.label: Gravity evaluation request
concepts.definition: Request to evaluate gravity at supplied positions.

concepts.label: Gravity evaluation response
concepts.definition: Gravity evaluation samples with the model provenance used to calculate them.

concepts.label: Gravity sample
concepts.definition: An evaluated position paired with its gravity evaluation result, including total acceleration and scalar total potential.

concepts.label: Gravity model provenance
concepts.definition: Identity and reproducibility information for an installed gravity model.

concepts.label: Model name
concepts.definition: Human-readable name used to select a scientific model.

concepts.label: Model identifier
concepts.definition: Published model identifier; not necessarily a UUID.

concepts.label: Model publisher
concepts.definition: Organization publishing the scientific model.

concepts.label: Model release date
concepts.definition: Publication calendar date of a scientific model.

concepts.label: Coefficient data version
concepts.definition: Version of the installed coefficient dataset.

concepts.label: Spherical-harmonic degree
concepts.definition: Maximum spherical-harmonic degree represented by a model; a nonnegative integer, not an angle.

concepts.label: Spherical-harmonic order
concepts.definition: Maximum spherical-harmonic order represented by a model; a nonnegative integer.

concepts.label: Calculation runtime version
concepts.definition: Version of the calculation implementation used for reproducibility.

concepts.label: Reference ellipsoid
concepts.definition: Identifier of the ellipsoid used for geographic coordinates.

concepts.label: Includes centrifugal acceleration
concepts.definition: Boolean declaration that total gravity includes centrifugal acceleration.

concepts.label: Coefficient SHA-256
concepts.definition: Hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the installed coefficient file.

concepts.label: North component
concepts.definition: Signed vector component positive along the local north axis.

concepts.label: East component
concepts.definition: Signed vector component positive along the local east axis.

concepts.label: Down component
concepts.definition: Signed vector component positive downward along the local vertical.

concepts.label: Vector magnitude
concepts.definition: Nonnegative Euclidean norm of a vector.

concepts.label: Input positions
concepts.definition: Positions supplied as inputs to an operation.

concepts.label: Output samples
concepts.definition: Evaluated samples returned by an operation.

concepts.label: Model provenance role
concepts.definition: Scientific model information supporting a result.

concepts.label: WGS84 ellipsoid convention
concepts.definition: WGS84 geodetic latitude/longitude with Greenwich origin and ellipsoidal depth positive downward; not a fully specified terrestrial frame realization or epoch.

concepts.label: Local North-East-Down
concepts.definition: Local north, east and downward axes at the evaluation position on WGS84; downward is opposite ellipsoidal up.

concepts.label: Gravity evaluation result
concepts.definition: Evaluated total gravity acceleration vector and scalar total gravity potential at a position, using a declared gravity model.

concepts.label: Geodetic position
concepts.definition: Position specified by geodetic latitude, longitude and an ellipsoid-relative vertical coordinate with a declared representation.

concepts.label: File content digest
concepts.definition: A digest computed from the byte content of a file using a specified digest algorithm.
constraints: A digest is not a model version or proof of authenticity.
Compare digests only with compatible algorithms, input-byte scope and representations.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of digest hierarchy and file roles, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: SHA-256 file digest
concepts.definition: A 256-bit digest computed from the complete byte content of a file using SHA-256.
constraints: SHA-256 is the digest algorithm; the provider declares the encoding of its 256-bit output.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of digest hierarchy and file roles, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Coefficient file
concepts.definition: Identifies the source file of a digest as a scientific model coefficient file.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of digest hierarchy and file roles, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Model metadata file
concepts.definition: Identifies the source file of a digest as a scientific model metadata file.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of digest hierarchy and file roles, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Dip
concepts.definition: Angular departure of a specified geometric object from a declared horizontal plane, measured in a specified vertical section. The specialization supplies object type, section, sign and range. No universal sign/range is imposed here.

concepts.label: Magnetic dip
concepts.definition: Signed angle of a magnetic flux-density vector from its horizontal projection, positive toward the declared downward axis. Requires position, instant, model and local frame. Undefined for the zero vector.

concepts.label: Magnetic declination
concepts.definition: Signed horizontal angle from geodetic north to the magnetic vector's horizontal projection, positive east. Requires position, instant, model and frame. Undefined when the horizontal projection is zero.

concepts.label: Earth magnetic flux density
concepts.definition: Component or magnitude of Earth's magnetic flux-density vector. A component or magnitude role specifies which scalar is represented. Requires position, instant and geomagnetic model; components require a frame.

concepts.label: Geomagnetic vector
concepts.definition: Earth's magnetic flux-density vector at a position and instant, expressed in a declared frame and evaluated with a declared model.

concepts.label: Instant
concepts.definition: A position on a time axis identified using a declared time scale and representation. Neither elapsed duration nor a calendar date alone.

concepts.label: Geodetic evaluation point
concepts.definition: A geodetic position paired with an evaluation instant. HasPart position and instant; is not a subtype of position merely because its JSON flattens coordinates and timestamp.

concepts.label: Geomagnetic sample
concepts.definition: An evaluation point paired with a geomagnetic vector and derived magnitudes and orientation angles. HasPart evaluation point, vector, magnetic dip and declination; EvaluatedUsing geomagnetic model provenance. Derived undefined angles are optional values.

concepts.label: Geomagnetic evaluation request
concepts.definition: A request to evaluate a selected geomagnetic model at supplied evaluation points. Execution and batching policies belong to the provider.

concepts.label: Geomagnetic evaluation response
concepts.definition: Evaluated geomagnetic samples with the model provenance supporting them. Ordering belongs to the provider.

concepts.label: Scientific model provenance
concepts.definition: Identity and reproducibility information for a scientific model and the implementation/data used to evaluate it.

concepts.label: Geomagnetic model provenance
concepts.definition: Identity, applicability and reproducibility information for a geomagnetic reference model.

concepts.label: Model selection token
concepts.definition: Provider-defined token selecting an installed model; its value set and mapping to model identity belong to that provider.

concepts.label: Horizontal magnitude
concepts.definition: Nonnegative Euclidean norm of a vector's projection onto the declared horizontal plane. Requires the projection plane. Not equivalent to the full-vector magnitude role.

concepts.label: Lower bound
concepts.definition: Lower endpoint of a declared ordered domain or interval. The binding identifies the bounded domain and whether the endpoint is included.

concepts.label: Upper bound
concepts.definition: Upper endpoint of a declared ordered domain or interval. The binding identifies the bounded domain and whether the endpoint is included.

concepts.label: Input evaluation points
concepts.definition: Evaluation points supplied to an operation. Does not imply ordering, completeness or atomicity.

concepts.label: Coordinated Universal Time
concepts.definition: UTC time-scale reference for a timestamp. Accepted serialization and representable precision are provider concerns.

concepts.label: Geoid-referenced depth
concepts.definition: Depth coordinate positive downward from a specified model geoid; the negative of the corresponding geoid-referenced height.
constraints: Not interchangeable with a local tidal datum, instantaneous sea surface or unspecified mean sea level.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Geoid undulation
concepts.definition: Signed height of a specified model geoid relative to a specified reference ellipsoid at a horizontal position, positive when the geoid is above the ellipsoid.
constraints: A separation between reference surfaces, not a point depth coordinate.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Position with geoid-referenced depth
concepts.definition: Position represented by geodetic latitude and longitude with a depth relative to a specified model geoid.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Geoid model provenance
concepts.definition: Identity and reproducibility information for a geoid model, its sampled data and evaluation method.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Angular grid spacing
concepts.definition: Angular separation between adjacent grid nodes along a declared coordinate axis.
constraints: Angular spacing is not a spatial distance or a model accuracy.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Geoid representation error
concepts.definition: Magnitude statistic of errors from a sampled geoid representation and its interpolation relative to the reference geoid model.
constraints: Not the geoid model error relative to the real Earth, nor the uncertainty of an input depth.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Maximum absolute error
concepts.definition: Role identifying a reported maximum absolute error over the stated evaluation domain.
constraints: A reported estimate is not automatically a rigorous bound.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Root mean square error
concepts.definition: Role identifying the square root of the mean squared errors over the stated sample population.
constraints: RMS error is not generally a standard deviation.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Interpolation method
concepts.definition: Named method used to estimate values between sampled data points.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Dataset timestamp
concepts.definition: Role identifying an instant supplied as a timestamp of a dataset; the provider declares the event represented.
constraints: Do not infer publication, creation or evaluation time from an unspecified dataset timestamp.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Vertical datum conversion request
concepts.definition: Request to express supplied vertical coordinates relative to another declared vertical reference.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Vertical datum conversion response
concepts.definition: Converted vertical-coordinate samples with the model provenance used for their conversion.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Vertical datum conversion sample
concepts.definition: An input position paired with a converted vertical coordinate and the reference-surface separation used in the conversion.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: EGM84 model geoid
concepts.definition: The geoid represented by the EGM84 model, used by this provider as its mean-sea-level reference surface.
requiredContext: model data realization and evaluation method
constraints: Not a local tidal datum or instantaneous sea surface.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md
